answer: An adversary hence has to keep every alias continuously active for 20 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The haven counter is kept in crystal and plume shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 20 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 935 identities would post 3373 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
